question: Which of the following is an approximate year (in BCE) of birth of Gautama Buddha?
solution: The correct answer is __**560 BCE**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Gautama Buddha**, also known as Siddhartha Gautama, was born approximately in **560 BCE** in Lumbini, which is located in present-day Nepal. • He was born into the **Shakya clan** to King Śuddhodana and Queen Māyā. Siddhartha's father was the ruler of the small kingdom of Kapilavastu. • Historians and Buddhist traditions generally agree upon **560 BCE** as an approximate date for his birth, though there are minor variations in dates based on different sources and traditions. • Gautama Buddha is the founder of **Buddhism**, one of the world's major religions, which emphasizes the path to enlightenment through ethical living, meditation, and wisdom. • The **birthplace of Buddha**, Lumbini, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and it holds great significance for Buddhists worldwide.
